desc: Edit LDB databases using your favorite editor
r: ldbrename - Edit LDB databases using your favorite editor
ldbrename is a utility that allows you to rename trees in an LDB database based by DN. This utility takes two arguments: the original DN name of the top element and the DN to change it to.

<dl><dt data-o="">-h</dt><dd>Show list of available options.</dd></dl> <dl><dt data-o="">-H <ldb-url></dt><dd>LDB URL to connect to. See ldb(3) for details.</dd></dl> <dl><dt data-o="">-o options</dt><dd>Extra ldb options, such as modules.</dd></dl>

LDB_URL

LDB URL to connect to (can be overridden by using the -H command-line option.)
This man page is correct for version 1.1 of LDB.

ldb was written by Andrew Tridgell[1].
